fullDescription: A high-contrast industrial intelligence dashboard designed for logistics, manufacturing, and SaaS management. The aesthetic combines a deep navy (#151936) sidebar with a vibrant orange-brand (#FCA624) accent and a clean off-white (#fcf8fb) workspace. It uses editorial-style typography with Montserrat, featuring heavy font weights (900) for headers and tight tracking for a premium corporate feel. Key features include a bento-style metrics grid, status-coded data tables, and a sticky header with a global search bar.

structured.summary: An industrial-grade dashboard with a fixed sidebar navigation, featuring a navy-and-orange brand palette, high-density data tables, and high-impact metric cards with micro-interactions.

style.description: The style is 'Industrial Modern' characterized by Montserrat typography (weights 400 to 900), high-contrast brand colors (Navy #151936, Orange-Brand #f7a526), and a systematic use of surface layers. Micro-interactions include smooth transitions on hover (0.2s duration) and scale-down effects on active buttons. The UI utilizes rounded corners (8px to 12px) and subtle shadows for depth.
style.prompt:
### Brand & Color Palette
- Primary Navy: `#151936` (used for sidebar and primary headers)
- Brand Orange: `#f7a526` (used for CTAs, active indicators, and high-impact widgets)
- Background: `#fcf8fb` (off-white for eye comfort)
- Surface Variants: `#f0edf0` (containers), `#e5e1e4` (borders/dividers)
- Status Colors: Green-50 (`#f0fdf4`) for success, Blue-50 (`#eff6ff`) for info, Red-50 (`#fef2f2`) for alerts

### Typography
- Font Family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif
- Page Titles: Font-size 32px, Weight 600, tracking-tight
- Section Headers: Font-size 18px, Weight 900, uppercase, tracking-tighter
- Table Headers: Font-size 11px, Weight 900, uppercase, tracking-widest (0.08em)
- Body Text: Font-size 14px, Weight 500/600

### Border & Spacing
- Radius: `8px` (standard cards), `12px` (feature widgets), `9999px` (buttons/pills)
- Gutter: `16px` (base), `40px` (main page padding)

### Animation
- Hover: `transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`
- Active: `transform: scale(0.95)` for primary buttons

layout_and_structure.description: The layout uses a two-pane architecture: a 280px fixed-width sidebar for navigation and a scrollable main content area with a sticky header.

prompts.prompt:
### Sidebar (280px fixed width)
- **Header**: Contains a 40x40px geometric SVG logo (Orange #FCA624 and Navy #121A36) paired with a brand name (Weight 900, 18px) and a sub-headline (Weight 700, 9px, uppercase).
- **Navigation Links**: Vertical list with 16px padding. Active state features a 4px wide, 24px tall orange vertical bar (`#f7a526`) on the far left and a semi-transparent white background (`white/10`).
- **Sync Widget**: An orange-brand card (`#f7a526`) at the bottom of the sidebar. Includes a 'Force Sync' button with a black background (`#000000`) and a circular icon.

### Top Navigation Bar (80px height)
- **Layout**: Flexbox with space-between. Sticky positioning at the top.
- **Search**: Large input with a pill-shaped radius (rounded-full), `#f6f2f6` background, and 48px left-padding for a search icon.
- **Action Cluster**: Right-side group with vertical divider, including notification bells, cart icons with badge overlays, and a user profile section (Avatar + Name + Help link).

### Title & Primary Actions
- Layout: Flex row with icons. 
- **Title Section**: 56x56px dark navy square icon with rounded-xl corners next to a 32px Montserrat title.
- **CTA Group**: Two buttons—one outlined (black border, 2px), one solid orange (with shadow-md).

### KPI Cards (4-column grid)
- **Structure**: White background, 1px border (`#e5e1e4`), 24px padding.
- **Top Row**: Label (10px, uppercase) and a light-themed categorical icon.
- **Middle Row**: High-contrast value (30px, black weight) and a percentage change label.
- **Bottom Row**: Descriptive subtext (12px).

### Document Management Table
- **Header**: Light gray background (`#f0edf0`), 20px vertical padding, uppercase text.
- **Rows**: 20px padding, hover effect with transition-colors to `#f6f2f6`.
- **Status Badges**: Rounded-full pill with a 6px center dot and text in font-weight 900. Colors vary by status (Success Green, Warning Orange, Info Blue).

special_ui_components.description: An orange feature card in the sidebar for critical status alerts.
special_ui_components.prompt: Design a card with background color `#f7a526`. Top section: a 'sync' icon and timestamp in uppercase tracking-widest text. Middle: Title in font-weight 900. Bottom: Full-width black button (`#000000`) with rounded-full corners and a 'Force Sync' label + arrow icon.

special_ui_components.description: A complex SVG mark involving multiple shapes.
special_ui_components.prompt: A 40x40 container holding a 96x96 orange rectangle, a primary orange play-button triangle, and a navy (#121A36) accent triangle positioned at the bottom center to create a multi-layered geometric industrial mark.

structured.special_notes: MUST use Montserrat for all text. MUST maintain the 280px sidebar width for layout consistency. MUST NOT use pure white for the main background; use #fcf8fb. Table headers MUST always be uppercase with letter spacing. All primary buttons MUST have an uppercase label with weight 900.
